subject: SELF and SUPER
notes: kb/Work PB1425 (w1014 group S, the qualified-SUPER mechanism). SR4 (cite.py --check 8.4.3.8.3 4) OK): object-class-name-1 shall name a class of the containing class's INHERITS clause. OoBindByReceiver resolves the qualifier through OoNameResolution (REPOSITORY scope) and refuses any class other than the containing class's base COBOL2777 (negative: the containing class itself named before OF SUPER). One receiver dispatch serves the INVOKE statement and the inline invocation (8.4.3.4.4 GR1).
